{{Top|leg}}
'''Heat Closure Packs''' were pressurized sealant bandages. When exposed to the air, medicines within the pack cauterized and sterilized wounds up to 10 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] large. Heat Closure Packs were standard items included in [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[ECM-598 Medical Backpack]].
